## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit message follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat: …`, `fix(ui): …`); the `commits` check enforces it
- [ ] The branch is rebased onto the current `main`; no merge commits
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `go test ./...` passes
- [ ] Screenshots attached if the window looks different
- [ ] No code for one particular game; no third-party song content, logos or art
